```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center")

pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "lubridate", "janitor", "googlesheets4",
          "plotly", "scales", "leaflet", "sf", "rnaturalearth",
          "rnaturalearthdata", "htmltools")
installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed]
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org", quiet = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(googlesheets4)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(htmltools)
```

```{r load-data, cache=TRUE}
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tU79rOh-fBCo6mKniF7kg56JVzGowrbxGee5nIMMkiA/edit?usp=sharing"
gs4_deauth()

parse_order_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(x)
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(as.Date(x))
  lubridate::mdy(as.character(x))
}

orders <- read_sheet(sheet_url) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    order_date = parse_order_date(order_date),
    sales      = as.numeric(sales),
    profit     = as.numeric(profit),
    year       = year(order_date),
    month_num  = month(order_date),
    month_name = factor(month.abb[month_num], levels = month.abb)
  )
```

```{r data-prep}
months_tbl <- tibble(month_num = 1:12,
                     month_name = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb))

make_monthly <- function(yr) {
  orders %>%
    filter(year == yr) %>%
    group_by(month_num) %>%
    summarise(sales  = sum(sales,  na.rm = TRUE),
              profit = sum(profit, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(months_tbl, by = "month_num") %>%
    arrange(month_num) %>%
    mutate(across(c(sales, profit), ~replace_na(., 0)))
}

monthly22 <- make_monthly(2022)
monthly21 <- make_monthly(2021)

dash22 <- orders %>% filter(year == 2022)

kpis <- dash22 %>%
  summarise(sales     = sum(sales,  na.rm = TRUE),
            profit    = sum(profit, na.rm = TRUE),
            customers = n_distinct(customer_id))

product_sales <- dash22 %>%
  group_by(sub_category) %>%
  summarise(sales = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(sales) %>%
  mutate(sub_category = factor(sub_category, levels = sub_category))

country_sales <- dash22 %>%
  group_by(country_region) %>%
  summarise(sales  = sum(sales,  na.rm = TRUE),
            profit = sum(profit, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r design-tokens}
navy   <- "#1B3A5C"
gold   <- "#B07D2E"
grey21_sales  <- "#9AAFC7"
grey21_profit <- "#C8B48A"
bg_col <- "#F2F4F6"
label_col <- "#5A6572"
title_col <- "#1B2A3B"
num_font  <- "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"

fmt_k <- function(x) ifelse(x >= 1000, paste0(round(x/1000, 0), "k"), as.character(round(x, 0)))

rcfg <- function(p) config(p, displayModeBar = FALSE, displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

## Market Overview {.map-kpi-slide}

```{r map-kpi-slide}
# ── Leaflet choropleth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
world_sf <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Join on sovereignt — avoids France overseas territory rows that share name="France"
# but have different sovereignt, causing the wrong polygon to get coloured.
# Normalise sheet names → sovereignt values used by rnaturalearth.
country_sales_map <- country_sales %>%
  mutate(sovereignt = case_when(
    country_region == "United Kingdom" ~ "United Kingdom",
    country_region == "Netherlands"    ~ "Netherlands",
    TRUE                               ~ country_region
  ))

# Restrict to Europe; join sales onto sovereignt field
europe_sf <- world_sf %>%
  filter(continent == "Europe" | sovereignt %in% c("Turkey", "Cyprus")) %>%
  left_join(country_sales_map, by = "sovereignt")

# Fill: white = 0 sales, navy = 300k sales
# No-data countries get a clear flat grey — visually separate from the white end of the scale
pal_fill <- colorNumeric(
  palette  = c("white", "#5B8DB8", navy),
  domain   = c(0, 325000),   # ceiling above France's 308k+ so it maps to full navy
  na.color = "#B0B8C1"
)

pal_legend <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("white", "#5B8DB8", navy),
  domain  = c(0, 325000),
  reverse = TRUE
)

country_map_leaf <- leaflet(europe_sf,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, attributionControl = FALSE)) %>%
  setView(lng = 10, lat = 52, zoom = 3) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor    = ~pal_fill(sales),
    fillOpacity  = 0.9,
    color        = "transparent",
    weight       = 0,
    smoothFactor = 0.8,
    label = ~ifelse(!is.na(sales),
      paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>Sales: ", scales::comma(round(sales, 0))),
      name) %>% lapply(htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(style = list("font-size" = "11px"))
  ) %>%
  # Static labels — navy at top = 300,000; white at bottom = 0
  # Using addLegend with explicit labels vector avoids any transform arithmetic
  addControl(
    html = paste0(
      '<div style="',
        'background:white; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:3px;',
        'font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:11px; color:#5A6572;',
        'box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);',
      '">',
      '<div style="font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px;">Sales</div>',
      '<div style="display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:6px;">',
        '<div style="',
          'width:12px; height:80px;',
          'background: linear-gradient(to bottom, ', navy, ', #5B8DB8, white);',
        '"></div>',
        '<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between;">',
          '<span>300,000</span>',
          '<span>150,000</span>',
          '<span>0</span>',
        '</div>',
      '</div>',
      '</div>'
    ),
    position = "bottomright"
  )

# ── KPI strip (HTML) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
kpi_block <- function(label, value) {
  tags$div(class = "kpi-card",
    tags$div(class = "kpi-label", label),
    tags$div(class = "kpi-value", scales::comma(round(value, 0)))
  )
}

kpi_strip <- tags$div(class = "kpi-strip",
  kpi_block("Total Sales",  kpis$sales),
  kpi_block("Total Profit", kpis$profit),
  kpi_block("Customers",    kpis$customers)
)

# ── Top 5 countries table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
top5 <- country_sales %>%
  arrange(desc(sales)) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number(), sales_fmt = paste0("$", scales::comma(round(sales, 0))))

top5_rows <- lapply(1:nrow(top5), function(i) {
  tags$tr(
    tags$td(style = "padding:4px 10px; color:#5A6572; font-size:10px;",
            paste0("#", top5$rank[i])),
    tags$td(style = "padding:4px 10px; font-weight:600; font-size:10px;",
            top5$country_region[i]),
    tags$td(style = paste0("padding:4px 10px; font-size:10px;",
                           "color:#1B3A5C; font-weight:700; text-align:right;"),
            top5$sales_fmt[i])
  )
})

top5_table <- tags$div(
  style = paste0(
    "margin-top:10px;",
    "border:1px solid #DDE1E7;",
    "background:#FFFFFF;",
    "box-sizing:border-box;"
  ),
  tags$div(
    style = paste0(
      "padding:6px 10px;",
      "border-bottom:2px solid #1B3A5C;",
      "font-family:Arial,sans-serif;",
      "font-size:9px; font-weight:700;",
      "letter-spacing:0.10em; text-transform:uppercase;",
      "color:#5A6572;"
    ),
    "Top 5 Countries by Sales"
  ),
  tags$table(
    style = "width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;",
    do.call(tagList, top5_rows)
  )
)

# Render map + KPI strip + top 5 table
tagList(
  tags$div(class = "map-container", country_map_leaf),
  kpi_strip,
  top5_table
)
```

## Country YoY Sales Change {.chart-slide}

```{r yoy-map-slide}
# Country-level YoY % change 2021 vs 2022
country_sales21 <- orders %>%
  filter(year == 2021) %>%
  group_by(country_region) %>%
  summarise(sales21 = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

country_yoy <- country_sales %>%
  left_join(country_sales21, by = "country_region") %>%
  mutate(
    sales21  = replace_na(sales21, 0),
    yoy_pct  = ifelse(sales21 == 0, NA,
                 round((sales - sales21) / sales21 * 100, 1)),
    yoy_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(yoy_pct), "No 2021 data",
                 ifelse(yoy_pct >= 0,
                   paste0("+", yoy_pct, "%"),
                   paste0(yoy_pct, "%"))),
    sovereignt = case_when(
      country_region == "United Kingdom" ~ "United Kingdom",
      country_region == "Netherlands"    ~ "Netherlands",
      TRUE ~ country_region
    )
  )

europe_yoy_sf <- world_sf %>%
  filter(continent == "Europe" | sovereignt %in% c("Turkey", "Cyprus")) %>%
  left_join(country_yoy, by = "sovereignt")

# Diverging palette: red = decline, white = flat, navy = growth
pal_yoy <- colorNumeric(
  palette  = c("#C0392B", "white", navy),
  domain   = c(-100, 100),
  na.color = "#B0B8C1"
)

leaflet(europe_yoy_sf,
    options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, attributionControl = FALSE)) %>%
  setView(lng = 10, lat = 52, zoom = 3) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor    = ~pal_yoy(yoy_pct),
    fillOpacity  = 0.85,
    color        = "transparent",
    weight       = 0,
    smoothFactor = 0.8,
    label = ~ifelse(!is.na(yoy_pct),
      paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>YoY Change: ", yoy_fmt,
             "<br>2022: $", scales::comma(round(sales, 0)),
             "<br>2021: $", scales::comma(round(sales21, 0))),
      paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>No data")) %>%
      lapply(htmltools::HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(style = list("font-size" = "11px"))
  ) %>%
  addControl(
    html = paste0(
      '<div style="background:white; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:3px;',
        'font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:11px; color:#5A6572;',
        'box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">',
      '<div style="font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px;">YoY Change</div>',
      '<div style="display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:6px;">',
        '<div style="width:12px; height:80px;',
          'background:linear-gradient(to bottom,', navy, ', white,', '#C0392B', ');"></div>',
        '<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between;">',
          '<span>+100%</span><span>0%</span><span>-100%</span>',
        '</div>',
      '</div></div>'
    ),
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

## Sales & Profit Trend {.chart-slide}

```{r trend-slide, fig.height=4.2, out.width="100%"}
# Offset x positions ±0.15 so overlapping year markers are both visible.
# customdata: col 1 = month name, col 2 = YoY % change vs same month 2021
monthly21_plot <- monthly21 %>%
  mutate(x_off = month_num - 0.15, mon = as.character(month_name))

monthly22_plot <- monthly22 %>%
  mutate(x_off     = month_num + 0.15,
         mon       = as.character(month_name),
         sales_pct = ifelse(monthly21$sales == 0, NA,
                      round((sales - monthly21$sales) / monthly21$sales * 100, 1)),
         profit_pct = ifelse(monthly21$profit == 0, NA,
                      round((profit - monthly21$profit) / monthly21$profit * 100, 1)),
         # Format as "+x%" or "-x%" for the hover label
         sales_pct_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(sales_pct),  "n/a",
                           ifelse(sales_pct  >= 0,
                             paste0("+", sales_pct,  "%"),
                             paste0(sales_pct,  "%"))),
         profit_pct_fmt = ifelse(is.na(profit_pct), "n/a",
                           ifelse(profit_pct >= 0,
                             paste0("+", profit_pct, "%"),
                             paste0(profit_pct, "%"))),
         # Bundle into customdata as list-column matrices so %{customdata[0]} and [1] work
         sales_cd  = purrr::map2(mon, sales_pct_fmt,  ~c(.x, .y)),
         profit_cd = purrr::map2(mon, profit_pct_fmt, ~c(.x, .y)))

trend_chart <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_trace(
    data = monthly21_plot, x = ~x_off, y = ~sales,
    customdata = ~mon,
    name = "Sales 2021", type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = grey21_sales, width = 1.5),
    marker = list(color = "white", size = 6, symbol = "circle",
                  line = list(color = grey21_sales, width = 1.5)),
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata} 2021: $%{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    data = monthly21_plot, x = ~x_off, y = ~profit,
    customdata = ~mon,
    name = "Profit 2021", type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line   = list(color = grey21_profit, width = 1.5, dash = "dot"),
    marker = list(color = "white", size = 6, symbol = "diamond",
                  line = list(color = grey21_profit, width = 1.5)),
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata} 2021: $%{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  # 2022 Sales — customdata = "Jan||+12.3%" parsed in hovertemplate
  add_trace(
    data = monthly22_plot, x = ~x_off, y = ~sales,
    customdata = ~sales_cd,
    name = "Sales 2022", type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line       = list(color = navy, width = 2.5),
    marker     = list(color = navy, size = 7),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    # customdata = "Jan||+12.3%" — split on || so [0]=month, [1]=pct
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata[0]} 2022: $%{y:,.0f}, %{customdata[1]}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  # 2022 Profit
  add_trace(
    data = monthly22_plot, x = ~x_off, y = ~profit,
    customdata = ~profit_cd,
    name = "Profit 2022", type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
    line       = list(color = gold, width = 2.5, dash = "dot"),
    marker     = list(color = gold, size = 7, symbol = "diamond"),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata[0]} 2022: $%{y:,.0f}, %{customdata[1]}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    xaxis = list(
      title = "", tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = 1:12, ticktext = month.abb,
      showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
      tickfont = list(size = 11)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "", tickformat = "~s", rangemode = "tozero",
      gridcolor = "#DDE1E7", zeroline = FALSE,
      tickfont = list(size = 11)
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.14,
      font = list(size = 10), bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ),
    # Peak annotation — find month with highest 2022 sales automatically
    annotations = list(
      list(
        x          = monthly22_plot$x_off[which.max(monthly22_plot$sales)],
        y          = max(monthly22_plot$sales),
        text       = paste0("<b>Peak: $",
                      scales::comma(round(max(monthly22_plot$sales), 0)), "</b>"),
        showarrow  = TRUE,
        arrowhead  = 2,
        arrowcolor = navy,
        ax         = 0, ay = -36,
        font       = list(size = 10, color = navy),
        bgcolor    = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)",
        bordercolor = navy,
        borderwidth = 1
      )
    ),
    margin        = list(l = 50, r = 20, t = 40, b = 40),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor  = "white",
    font = list(family = num_font, color = label_col)
  ) %>%
  rcfg()

trend_chart
```

## Revenue by Category {.chart-slide}

```{r product-slide, fig.height=4.8, out.width="100%"}
# 2021 product sales for comparison
product_sales21 <- orders %>%
  filter(year == 2021) %>%
  group_by(sub_category) %>%
  summarise(sales = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Join so both years share the same category order (driven by 2022 rank)
product_both <- product_sales %>%
  rename(sales22 = sales) %>%
  left_join(product_sales21 %>% rename(sales21 = sales), by = "sub_category") %>%
  mutate(sales21 = replace_na(sales21, 0))

# Hover label appears to the right: use hoverinfo + hoverlabel
product_bar <- plot_ly() %>%
  # 2021 bars — grey, inside labels
  add_bars(
    data        = product_both,
    x           = ~sales21, y = ~sub_category,
    name        = "2021",
    orientation = "h",
    marker      = list(color = grey21_sales,
                       line  = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
    text        = "",
    textposition = "none",
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>2021: $%{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    hoverlabel  = list(bgcolor = grey21_sales, font = list(color = "white", size = 11),
                       align = "left")
  ) %>%
  # 2022 bars — navy, inside labels
  add_bars(
    data        = product_both,
    x           = ~sales22, y = ~sub_category,
    name        = "2022",
    orientation = "h",
    marker      = list(color = navy,
                       line  = list(color = "white", width = 0.5)),
    text        = "",
    textposition = "none",
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>2022: $%{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    hoverlabel  = list(bgcolor = navy, font = list(color = "white", size = 11),
                       align = "left")
  ) %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    barmode  = "group",    # side-by-side 2021 vs 2022
    xaxis = list(
      title = "", tickformat = "~s",
      showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
      tickfont = list(size = 11)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = as.character(product_both$sub_category),
      tickfont = list(size = 10)
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.06,
      font = list(size = 10), bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ),
    hoverlabel = list(namelength = -1),
    margin        = list(l = 100, r = 20, t = 35, b = 40),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor  = "white",
    font = list(family = num_font, color = label_col)
  ) %>%
  rcfg()

product_bar
```

## Top 5 Categories - YoY Change {.chart-slide}

```{r top5-cat-slide, fig.height=4.2, out.width="100%"}
# Top 5 categories by 2022 sales, with YoY % change
top5_cat <- product_both %>%
  mutate(custom_order = case_when(
    sub_category == "Copiers"    ~ 1,
    sub_category == "Bookcases"  ~ 2,
    sub_category == "Phones"     ~ 3,
    sub_category == "Storage"    ~ 4,
    sub_category == "Appliances" ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ 99
  )) %>%
  filter(custom_order < 99) %>%
  arrange(custom_order) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change   = round((sales22 - sales21) / sales21 * 100, 1),
    pct_fmt      = ifelse(pct_change >= 0,
                     paste0("+", pct_change, "%"),
                     paste0(pct_change, "%")),
    bar_col      = ifelse(pct_change >= 0, navy, "#C0392B"),
    sub_category = factor(sub_category,
                     levels = c("Appliances", "Storage", "Phones", "Bookcases", "Copiers"))
  )

top5_cat_bar <- plot_ly(top5_cat) %>%
  # 2021 bars — grey
  add_bars(
    x = ~sales21, y = ~sub_category,
    name = "2021", orientation = "h",
    marker = list(color = grey21_sales),
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>2021: $%{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  # 2022 bars — navy or red depending on growth
  add_bars(
    x = ~sales22, y = ~sub_category,
    name = "2022", orientation = "h",
    marker = list(color = ~bar_col),
    text   = ~pct_fmt,
    textposition = "outside",
    textfont = list(size = 11, color = ~bar_col),
    cliponaxis = FALSE,
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{y}</b><br>2022: $%{x:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    barmode  = "group",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "", tickformat = "~s",
      showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
      tickfont = list(size = 11)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = c("Appliances", "Storage", "Phones", "Bookcases", "Copiers"),
      tickfont = list(size = 11)
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.08,
      font = list(size = 10), bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
    ),
    margin        = list(l = 100, r = 70, t = 35, b = 40),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor  = "white",
    font = list(family = num_font, color = label_col)
  ) %>%
  rcfg()

top5_cat_bar
```

## Profitability Snapshot {.chart-slide}

```{r profitability-slide, results='asis'}
# Overall margins
margin22 <- round(kpis$profit / kpis$sales * 100, 1)

profit21 <- orders %>%
  filter(year == 2021) %>%
  summarise(sales = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE), profit = sum(profit, na.rm = TRUE))
margin21 <- round(profit21$profit / profit21$sales * 100, 1)

margin_chg    <- round(margin22 - margin21, 1)
margin_chg_fmt <- ifelse(margin_chg >= 0, paste0("+", margin_chg, "pp"), paste0(margin_chg, "pp"))

profit_chg_pct <- round((kpis$profit - profit21$profit) / profit21$profit * 100, 1)
profit_chg_fmt <- ifelse(profit_chg_pct >= 0, paste0("+", profit_chg_pct, "%"), paste0(profit_chg_pct, "%"))

card_col <- function(val) ifelse(val >= 0, navy, "#C0392B")

HTML(paste0('
<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap:16px; margin-top:20px;">

  <div style="border:1px solid #DDE1E7; border-top:3px solid ', navy, '; padding:20px 24px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
    <div style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5A6572; margin-bottom:8px;">Profit Margin 2022</div>
    <div style="font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:#1B2A3B; line-height:1;">',  margin22, '%</div>
  </div>

  <div style="border:1px solid #DDE1E7; border-top:3px solid ', navy, '; padding:20px 24px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
    <div style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5A6572; margin-bottom:8px;">Profit Margin 2021</div>
    <div style="font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:#1B2A3B; line-height:1;">',  margin21, '%</div>
  </div>

  <div style="border:1px solid #DDE1E7; border-top:3px solid ', card_col(margin_chg), '; padding:20px 24px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
    <div style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5A6572; margin-bottom:8px;">Margin Change (pp)</div>
    <div style="font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:', card_col(margin_chg), '; line-height:1;">', margin_chg_fmt, '</div>
  </div>

</div>

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); gap:16px; margin-top:16px;">

  <div style="border:1px solid #DDE1E7; border-top:3px solid ', navy, '; padding:20px 24px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
    <div style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5A6572; margin-bottom:8px;">Total Profit 2022</div>
    <div style="font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:#1B2A3B; line-height:1;">$', scales::comma(round(kpis$profit, 0)), '</div>
  </div>

  <div style="border:1px solid #DDE1E7; border-top:3px solid ', card_col(profit_chg_pct), '; padding:20px 24px; font-family:Arial,sans-serif;">
    <div style="font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5A6572; margin-bottom:8px;">YoY Profit Change</div>
    <div style="font-size:36px; font-weight:700; color:', card_col(profit_chg_pct), '; line-height:1;">', profit_chg_fmt, '</div>
  </div>

</div>
'))
```

## Key Takeaways {.agenda-slide}

```{r takeaways-slide, results='asis'}
# Auto-derive insights from data
top_country    <- country_sales %>% arrange(desc(sales)) %>% slice(1)
top_country_share <- round(top_country$sales / kpis$sales * 100, 1)

top_cat22      <- product_both %>% arrange(desc(sales22)) %>% slice(1)
top_cat_pct    <- round((top_cat22$sales22 - top_cat22$sales21) / top_cat22$sales21 * 100, 1)
top_cat_fmt    <- ifelse(top_cat_pct >= 0, paste0("+", top_cat_pct, "%"), paste0(top_cat_pct, "%"))

sales21_total  <- orders %>% filter(year == 2021) %>% summarise(s = sum(sales, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(s)
total_sales_pct <- round((kpis$sales - sales21_total) / sales21_total * 100, 1)
total_sales_fmt <- ifelse(total_sales_pct >= 0, paste0("+", total_sales_pct, "%"), paste0(total_sales_pct, "%"))

margin22_val   <- round(kpis$profit / kpis$sales * 100, 1)
margin21_val   <- round(profit21$profit / profit21$sales * 100, 1)
margin_dir     <- ifelse(margin22_val >= margin21_val, "improved", "declined")

customers21_n  <- orders %>% filter(year == 2021) %>% summarise(n = n_distinct(customer_id)) %>% pull(n)
cust_pct       <- round((kpis$customers - customers21_n) / customers21_n * 100, 1)
cust_fmt       <- ifelse(cust_pct >= 0, paste0("+", cust_pct, "%"), paste0(cust_pct, "%"))

peak_month     <- monthly22 %>% slice(which.max(sales)) %>% pull(month_num) %>% month(label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE) %>% as.character()

insights <- list(
  paste0("<b>", top_country$country_region, "</b> is the top market, representing ",
         top_country_share, "% of total 2022 EU revenue ($",
         scales::comma(round(top_country$sales, 0)), ")."),
  paste0("Total EU sales ", total_sales_fmt, " YoY, reaching $",
         scales::comma(round(kpis$sales, 0)), " in 2022."),
  paste0("<b>", top_cat22$sub_category, "</b> led all categories with $",
         scales::comma(round(top_cat22$sales22, 0)), " in sales (", top_cat_fmt, " YoY)."),
  paste0("Profit margin ", margin_dir, " from ", margin21_val, "% in 2021 to ",
         margin22_val, "% in 2022."),
  paste0("Customer base grew ", cust_fmt, " YoY to ", scales::comma(kpis$customers),
         " customers. Sales peaked in <b>", peak_month, "</b>.")
)

rows <- paste0(
  mapply(function(txt, num) {
    paste0(
      '<div class="agenda-item">',
        '<span class="agenda-num">', sprintf("%02d", num), '</span>',
        '<div class="agenda-text">',
          '<div class="agenda-desc" style="font-size:12px; color:#1B2A3B;">', txt, '</div>',
        '</div>',
      '</div>'
    )
  }, insights, seq_along(insights)),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0('<div class="agenda-block">', rows, '</div>'))
```
